newsitem.title: FINLAND: Nokia names Kallasvuo head of Americas. [CORRECTED 13:15 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Nokia names Kallasvuo head of Americas. [CORRECTED 13:15 GMT]

text.p: Finnish telecommunications group Nokia Oy said in a statement on Wednesday Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer Olli-Pekka Kallasvuo had been appointed executive vice president, Nokia Americas.

Sari Baldauf, president of Nokia Telecommunications, Cellular Syatems, was named executive vice president, Nokia APAC (Asia-Pacific), it said. (Corrects Baldauf's designation to make clear she is not head of all of Nokia Telecommunications).
Both will report to President and CEO Jorma Ollila.
"As of January 1, Nokia will implement group-wide regional organisations in the Asia-Pacific area and in the North and South Americas," it said.
"The changes to be implemented continue the development started in 1992," Ollila said in the statement.
"The new operation mode with emphasis on cross-business- group cooperation will increase efficiency in exploiting Nokia's total skills in the telecommunications business," he added.
Nokia aimed "to be able to operate faster and more efficiently and ... offer more value-added to ... customers", Ollila said.
Both Kallasvuo and Baldauf will remain members of the group executive board, Nokia said.
Each of the three business groups -- Telecommunications, Mobile Phones and General Communication Products -- would "continue to carry the global responsibility in its total operations", it said.
Corporate controller Maija Torkko was appointed senior vice president finance and control, Nokia said.
